Subject: Re: LongTail RFP — commercial/pricing section (attached)

Folks — attaching the draft pricing matrix (xlsx referenced in thread). Summary below — numbers are hosted API list rates, then proposed pilot/commit paths and overage tiers.

Key assumptions: 1) Pilot = 90d, up to 5M generation tokens + 100k embeddings vectors (flat pilot fee cover) 2) Conversion credit applies if customer signs an annual commit within 60d of pilot close 3) Embeddings billed per 1k vectors at a separate unit.

Commercial summary (proposed):
- List (hosted): generation $0.020 /1K tokens; embeddings $0.0025 /1K vectors.
- Pilot (90d): flat pilot fee $3,750 which covers up to 5M generation tokens and up to 100k embeddings vectors; overage during pilot billed at pilot overage rate generation $0.015 /1K, embeddings $0.002 /1K.
- Annual committed path (recommended tiers, blended pricing shown):
  * Tier A: 100M tokens annual commit -> blended $0.012 /1K
  * Tier B: 300M tokens annual commit -> blended $0.010 /1K
  * Tier C: 1B tokens annual commit -> blended $0.008 /1K
- Step-down mechanism: as realized monthly consumption exceeds thresholds, price for that month steps down to the corresponding tier; effective monthly billing reflects the step-down (not retroactive beyond quarter).
- Overage bands (no commit): overage billed at list but with automatic smoothing credits if monthly spike > 25% above trailing 3-month average: first 20% at list, next 30% at list * 0.85, >50% requires review and eligible for one-time surge credit up to 10% of surge overage if customer moves to a committed tier within 45d.
- Graceband & true-up: annual true-up with 30d invoice offset; customers moving from hosted -> dedicated receive conversion credit equal to unused commit pro-rata up to 25% of pilot fee (applies once).
- Dedicated option (reserved capacity): reserved node pricing available; example: 1 x A40-equivalent reserved pool $11,000/month (includes baseline throughput and 24/7 SLA). Dedicated pricing to be quoted based on target qps and model type.

Open items for commercial team: invoice frequency (monthly vs quarterly prepay), early payment discount (Rishi — recommend 0.5% for net15 vs net30?), and whether to include a capped mitigation credit for model-quality regressions.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-matrix-longtail-v2.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LongTail RFP — commercial/pricing section (attached)

Thanks Ben — good first pass, I have a few suggested guardrails before we send externally: 

1) Pilot -> conversion credit: increase to up to 50% of pilot fee as credit (applies against first invoice only) to smooth pilot->commit conversion; restrict to annual commits >= Tier A (100M).
2) Step-down retro: make step-down effective the same month consumption crosses the threshold but do not make price retroactive beyond that month; this avoids downstream reconciliation complexity.
3) Overage smoothing: change automatic smoothing credits to: first 25% of spike at list, next 25% at 90% of list, >50% requires commercial review. Remove the one-time surge credit — instead offer an "emergency burst" add-on as a paid uplift option (25% premium) for immediate capacity.
4) Embeddings: propose a separate reserved embedding bundle for high-query customers: 1M vector queries/month = $1,800/month (dedicated bundle), otherwise keep per-1k unit pricing.
5) Payment terms: recommend standard Net30 with 1% discount for Net15, but allow Net45 for public sector after PO. Rishi to confirm from finance if Net15 discount ok.

If Rishi signs off, we should prepare two outbound artifacts: (A) commercial-terms-summary-longtail.pdf (clean language, redlines called out) and (B) the pricing matrix xlsx. Hannah/Marissa — I'll review the external language on the step-down clause.

Karthik
Head of Commercial Strategy

Subject: Redwood commercial response — LongTail Health RFP (pilot + annual commit options)

Emma / LongTail team —

Appreciate the clear RFP. Please find our commercial response and supporting materials attached: redwood-pricing-matrix-longtail-v2.xlsx and commercial-terms-summary-longtail.pdf. Highlights below to make review easier.

Summary highlights:
- Pilot: 90-day pilot, flat fee $3,750 covering up to 5M gen tokens and 100k embeddings vectors. Pilot overage rates (generation $0.015 /1K; embeddings $0.002 /1K). Pilot conversion credit: up to 50% of pilot fee applied to first invoice if LongTail signs an annual commit >= 100M tokens within 60 days of pilot end.
- Annual commit tiers (hosted): Tier A 100M -> $0.012/1K blended; Tier B 300M -> $0.010/1K blended; Tier C 1B -> $0.008/1K blended. Step-down pricing applies from the month thresholds are crossed (not retroactive beyond that month).
- Overage & spike handling: normal overages billed at list; automatic smoothing applies for spikes up to 50% above trailing three-month baseline (graduated discounts as detailed in matrix). For immediate capacity beyond smoothing, we offer a paid emergency burst add-on (25% premium) or a move-to-dedicated engagement (quoted separately).
- Embeddings: per-1k vector query price shown; high-volume embedding customers can opt for a reserved bundle (example provided in matrix).
- Dedicated (reserved pool): quoted separately based on throughput and model selection; example baseline node pricing included in PDF.
- Payment & terms: Net30 standard; 1% early-pay discount for Net15; annual true-up with 30d invoice offset.

Next steps / asks:
- Please confirm whether you want the pilot scoped to the patient-summary model only, or include the triage/NLU model in scope (impacts pilot token estimate).
- If the timeline still needs the commercial term sheet by 11/01, we can provide a redline-ready PDF with signature-ready terms; otherwise we recommend time for a short negotiation call the week of 11/08.

I've copied Marissa to coordinate the commercial call and Ben for any SOW-level throughput sizing questions.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-matrix-longtail-v2.xlsx, commercial-terms-summary-longtail.pdf
